title: 第800章 沈耀阳第799章 北蛮兽人
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
沈算连喝了三杯凉茶，却怎么也不能将心头那股烦闷挥之，眼神不由有些发直。
就当他快要陷入牛角尖之时。
钟源快步走进来，瞧见自家少爷面露倦色，不由一愣，随即轻声道：“少爷。”
“何事？”沈算揉了揉眉心。
“大少爷来访。”钟源压低声音。
“大少爷？”沈算抬眼，一脸茫然。
“是您大堂哥。”钟源小声提醒。
“不见。”沈算摆手。
话音刚落，院门外已传来一道不请自来的声音：“六弟何必如此拒人千里。”
话音未落，一个身着华服、年约三十出头的青年踱步而入。他相貌堂堂，眉宇间却透着一股倨傲。
沈算嘴角勾起一丝讥讽：“我是怕身上的不详，传染给高高在上的大少爷，再扩大传染到您那些亲朋好友。”
青年脸色微变，旋即扯出一抹笑：“六弟说笑了。”
沈算懒得虚与委蛇，直问：“不知耀阳族兄找我有何事？”
沈耀阳听到“族兄”二字，笑容顿时僵住，冷下脸来：“我是你大兄。”
“我没有大兄。”沈算抬眸，目光平静却冷冽，“莫忘了如今你我的身份。喊你一声族兄，是顾念我父亲。你……要识趣。”
话音未落，一股威压自沈算体内轰然爆发，如山岳倾覆，直直压向沈耀阳。
“你——！”沈耀阳惊怒交加，话未出口便被逼得蹬蹬连退数步，脸色涨红，额头青筋暴起，竟连站稳都费了大力气。
沈算淡淡扫了他一眼：“四品巅峰，竟是这般虚浮。当真是浪费资源。”
沈耀阳死死咬着牙，胸口剧烈起伏，却一个字都说不出来。
“你的来意？”沈算收回威压，冷声再问。

沈耀阳深吸一口气，强压下怒火，声音低沉：“爷爷今晚设家宴，让我来——”
“不去。”沈算断然摆手，转头看向钟源，“源哥，送客。”
“是。”钟源上前，冲沈耀阳做了个请的手势。
“六弟……”
“滚。”沈算抬眸，那双平日里温润的眼睛此刻冷如寒潭，隐有杀机一闪而过。
沈耀阳心头一紧，脊背发凉，再不敢多言，转身快步离去。
华服下摆仓皇一甩，哪还有半分来时的傲慢。
待他的身影消失在院门外，沈算长长呼出一口气，整个人像泄了气的皮球，靠在椅背上。
方才那汹涌的杀机，并非他本意，而是记忆中积压了十数年的怨气在那一刻冲破了堤坝。
他闭上眼，脑海中浮现出记忆画面——父母失踪，他孤身一人被丢在这座偌大的沈园里。
沈耀阳霸占了他父母留下的产业，散布他是不详的传闻，暗中打压，明里冷落，一步一步将他逼入绝境。
而那些所谓的亲人，长辈视而不见，兄弟姐妹落井下石，没有一个人站出来替他说过一句话。
当真是一群牲畜。
幸好，他还有钟宇他们！
沈算睁开眼，给自己倒上已经凉透的茶，一口饮尽，苦味在舌尖蔓延。
他站起身，念叨着：“不生气，不生气，气出病来无人替……”迈步往外走。
content_en:
Shen Suan drank three cups of herbal tea in a row, but he couldn't get rid of the annoyance in his heart, and his eyes couldn't help but straighten.
Just when he was about to fall into a corner.
Zhong Yuan walked in quickly and saw his young master looking tired. He couldn't help but be startled, and then said softly: "Young Master."
"What's the matter?" Shen Suan rubbed his eyebrows.
"The young master is here to visit." Zhong Yuan lowered his voice.
"Young Master?" Shen Suan raised his eyes with a confused look on his face.
"It's your cousin." Zhong Yuan reminded in a low voice.
"No." Shen Suan waved his hand.
As soon as he finished speaking, an uninvited voice came from outside the courtyard door: "Sixth brother, why do you reject others like this?"
Before he finished speaking, a young man in his early thirties dressed in Chinese clothes walked in. He has a dignified appearance, but there is a sense of arrogance between his brows.
There was a trace of sarcasm on Shen Suan's lips: "I'm afraid that the unknown thing about me will be transmitted to the arrogant young master, and then spread to your relatives and friends."
The young man's face changed slightly, and he immediately smiled: "Sixth brother is joking."
Shen Suan was too lazy to make excuses and asked directly: "I wonder what Brother Yaoyang wants to see me for?"
When Shen Yaoyang heard the word "brother", his smile suddenly froze and his face turned cold: "I am your eldest brother."
"I don't have an elder brother." Shen Suan raised his eyes, his eyes calm but cold, "Don't forget who you and I are now. Calling you brother is because I care about my father. You... have to be sensible."
Before he finished speaking, a force of coercion suddenly erupted from Shen Suan's body, like a mountain overturning, pressing directly towards Shen Yaoyang.
"You——!" Shen Yaoyang was shocked and angry. Before he could say anything, he was forced to step back several steps. His face turned red and veins popped up on his forehead. It took a lot of effort to even stand firm.
Shen Suan glanced at him lightly: "The fourth-level peak is so vain. It's really a waste of resources."
Shen Yaoyang gritted his teeth, his chest heaved violently, but he couldn't say a word.
"What's your purpose of coming?" Shen Suan withdrew his pressure and asked again in a cold voice.
Shen Yaoyang took a deep breath, suppressed his anger, and said in a low voice: "Grandpa is hosting a family dinner tonight, let me come -"
"I'm not going." Shen Suan waved his hands decisively and turned to look at Zhong Yuan, "Brother Yuan, see the guest off."
"Yes." Zhong Yuan stepped forward and made an inviting gesture to Shen Yaoyang.
"Sixth brother..."
"Get lost." Shen Suan raised his eyes. His usually gentle eyes were now as cold as a cold pool, with a hint of murderous intent flashing through him.
Shen Yaoyang's heart tightened and a chill ran down his spine. He didn't dare to say more, turned around and left quickly.
The hem of the gorgeous clothes was swung hastily, and there was no trace of the arrogance that he had before.
After his figure disappeared outside the courtyard gate, Shen Suan took a long breath and leaned back on the chair like a deflated rubber ball.
The raging murderous intention just now was not his original intention, but the resentment accumulated in his memory for more than ten years broke through the dam at that moment.
He closed his eyes, and a memory picture appeared in his mind - his parents were missing, and he was left alone in this huge sunken garden.
Shen Yaoyang occupied the property left by his parents, spread rumors that he was an unknown person, secretly suppressed him, overtly ignored him, and pushed him into a desperate situation step by step.
As for the so-called relatives, the elders turned a blind eye, the brothers and sisters made trouble, and no one stood up and said a word for him.
What a bunch of livestock.
Fortunately, he still has Zhong Yu and the others!
Shen Suan opened his eyes, poured himself some cold tea, and drank it all in one gulp, the bitter taste spreading on his tongue.
He stood up and muttered: "Don't be angry, don't be angry, there is no one to take care of you when you get angry..." and walked out.
